cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 64% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +1.58% · WTI +1.90% · Brent +2.80% · NatGas -0.07%. 64% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Renewables & Solar is doing the heavy lifting at +1.75%.

cards.headline: Renewables & Solar leads, Grid, Storage & Electrification lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Renewables & Solar at +1.75%; weakest is Grid, Storage & Electrification at -2.93%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: RUN is the standout at +21.16%
cards.body: Leaders: RUN +21.16%, FSLR +4.94%, FTI +4.65%, SEDG +3.26%, ARRY +2.96%. Laggards: BE -5.13%, VRT -3.64%, LEU -3.33%, GEV -3.11%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.

cards.headline: FSLR moving on no clear catalyst
cards.body: FSLR is +5.14% with no fresh headline this cycle — attention without a story. Volume, not news, is doing the work.
